summary: New sense 2: Grundbesitz amtlich registrieren, eintragen lassen
rationale: Court proceedings, title deeds and registration in the Syriacs’ name identify legal property registration, distinct from tape recording. One clear attestation.

data.turoyo: Tloṯo, arbʕo yawme b Mor Barṣawmo ʕam am maṣəṯone w a mfarǧonayḏan, msaǧeli m Xori Noʕman kmo ḥəkkoyat.
data.translation: Drei bis vier Tage habe ich in Mor Barsaumo mit Zuhörern und Zuschauern Geschichten von Chori Noʕman aufgenommen.

rationale: Thin Preterit: overt story object, source speaker and recording interval.

data.turoyo: B lalyo, bəṯr m ḥšəmto huli xabro lu xori w tavda naḥitina li diwanxana d Mor Barṣawmo, lašan d msaǧanno awwəl ḥəkkoye.
data.translation: Am ab End, nach dem Nachtmahl, sagte ich dem Chorbischof Bescheid und wir gingen zusammen nach dem Versammlungsraum von Mor Barsaumo hinunter, um die erste Geschichte aufzunehmen.

rationale: Thin Infectum: first story recorded, clear purpose clause and recording setting.

data.turoyo: Bəṯr b kmo yawme ənšallah d miʕadəl, i naqlayo gəmsaǧalno ḥəs diḏe.
data.translation: Wenn er, hoffentlich, nach ein Paar Tagen wiederhergestellt ist, werde ich dann seine Stimme auf das Tonband aufnehmen.

rationale: Thin Infectum: prospective recording, explicit voice object and recovery condition.

data.turoyo: Kobaʕ msaǧal w koṯaw u mede, d aṯi b qarʕa di mšiḥoyuṯo b Ṭur ʕAbdin bila baq qəryawoṯe. <...>
data.translation: [Er möchte] das, was den Christen im Turabdin, auch in den Dörfern, passiert ist, aufnehmen und aufschreiben. <...>

rationale: Fill Infectum to five: testimony as shared object of recording and writing, with the edition's bracketed subject retained.

data.turoyo: I maḥkame lulalanyo, bəṯər u ‘Tamiz Maḥkamasi‘ hulelan ḥaq w ftəḥlan w msaǧelan w səmlan ʕal əšme das səryoye. Uʕdo aṭ ṭapowat, an arʕoṯayḏe, u məlkayḏe w u ṭurayḏe kule ṭapo yo ʕal əšme das səryoye.
data.translation: The first court, then the Court of Cassation, gave us the right, and we opened it and registered it and put it in the name of the Syriacs. Now those title deeds, its lands, its property and its mountain, all of it is held by title deed in the name of the Syriacs.

rationale: Sole Preterit example of legal-registration sense 2; title-deed continuation makes the technical meaning independently recoverable.

data.turoyo: Fayəšno sawo ste šabṯo. Msaǧəlile a tmənyo naḥle du qərowo, maḥ 65. <...>
data.translation: I stayed with him another week. He recorded for me the eight modes of the liturgy, in 1965. <...>

rationale: Thin Preterit/1 cell after round 1; liturgical modes as content with a beneficiary suffix.

summary: The technical recording meaning is already explicit in II.1. Oral history, stories, hymns and voices all remain within it; no new technical sense is warranted.
The recording participant can be the operator (15/8) or the person supplying spoken content (15/7). The Turoyo does not separately express speak in the latter; the translation's wording is preserved.
Valency includes zero-marked voice/story objects, suffixal content in msaǧannolən (11/204), m- source speakers, and b- recording apparatus. The l-suffix indexes content here, not a recipient.
Preterit, Preterit-wa, purpose/modal Infectum and prospective Infectum contrast, without changing the core recording event. səǧolaṯṯe (11/200) has content encoded in a possessive suffix.
The Arabic-derived II verb is a lexical recording verb, not a light-verb phrase. No new idiom is established.

The inherited Preterit reference bundle includes both 11/173 and 11/315; its text illustrates 11/173. The latter has two separate recording tokens, which are retained in decisions without duplicate quotations.

The Arabic-derived recording verb spans two technical domains: sound recording and official property registration. Do not widen auf’s Tonband nehmen into an unspecified recording gloss that obscures this contrast.
The liturgical recording continues the content range already observed in round 1; it adds a beneficiary alongside the operator/content roles.
Should the inherited bundled reference 11/173, 315 be separated for editorial clarity? It currently lists a supporting verse as well as the exact quoted verse; no citation is silently changed.
Confirm the exact agent/beneficiary suffix segmentation of Msaǧəlile (Jan 2.10/2349); the supplied interpretation has a third-person operator and first-person beneficiary.

rationale: The preposition has lost its initial a. The supplied translation of 11/301 reads sie auf das Gerät aufgenommen.
Nacht is a German noun; the supplied edition translation also has in jener Nacht.
